notes: Pixel-exact sprites segmented from the ZRPG sheets. Each sprite PNG is masked: only its own pixels, transparent elsewhere. src = bounding box in the source sheet; atlas = rectangle in atlas[index]. anchor = foot point in sprite pixels (place sprite so anchor sits on the map position; y-sort by it). terrain/water anchor at top-left.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: Standing trees and palms (incl. dead trees, palm trunk/crown segments). Usually with cast shadow.

classes.name: bush
classes.description: Shrubs, cacti, ferns, leafy vines and overhangs: mid-size ground vegetation that blocks or decorates.

classes.name: plant
classes.description: Small vegetation: flowers, sprouts, tufts, reeds, mushrooms, grass-blade scatter decals.

classes.name: rock
classes.description: Rocks: mesas, cliffs, pillars, boulders, crystal/ore nodes, pebbles.

classes.name: terrain
classes.description: Ground art drawn under everything: grass/sand/gravel tiles, patches, autotile masks, pits, decals.

classes.name: prop
classes.description: Objects: logs, signposts, planters, tent, lantern, hive, bones, skulls, shells, starfish, coral.
